rapport_notes: Warm and unhurried; let the price-sensitive customer go gracefully without any pushiness.

evidence_quotes.agenda: "did you have any concerns or questions right off the top."
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: N/A -- customer said no concerns upfront
